scheme: The GHFDB quality scheme, following Fuchs et al. (2023) with its 2026 corrigendum
notes: inputs are keyed by field code. A field that is absent is empty. A list holds several values of a field.
expected holds only what the example asserts. T and TC are null when not determined, never 0.
scoring is 'child' by default. 'measurement' means a gradient or conductivity scored on its own, before the child's correction rules.
expected.measurement holds the scores of the child's gradient and conductivity before the child's correction rules.
portal_tests names the tests that assert the example, as path::node: the GHFDB portal's, relative to the portal repository, or this package's, under tests/test_qc/.
criteria names the criteria of the scheme the example exercises.

criteria.routing.probe-sensing: A child is scored by the probe-sensing rules
criteria.routing.borehole-and-mine: A child is scored by the borehole and mine rules
criteria.routing.not-determined: No rules apply, so the scores are not determined
criteria.u.bands: The four classes of the coefficient of variation
criteria.u.rounding: The coefficient is rounded to six places
criteria.u.sign: The sign of the value and of the uncertainty is ignored
criteria.u.not-determined: Value or uncertainty empty or zero
criteria.probe-t.elevation-not-below-sea-level: An elevation at or above sea level has no water depth
criteria.probe-t.tilt-waiver: A tilt correction waives the tilt criterion
criteria.probe-t.water-depth-waiver: A bottom-water correction waives the water depth criterion
criteria.probe-tc.saturation: Saturation, method, source and location together
criteria.probe-tc.number-not-scored-for-literatur: The number is not scored for a literature location (probe sensing)
criteria.borehole-t.continuous-log-needs-more-tha: A continuous log needs more than three recordings
criteria.borehole-t.unresolvable-method: Temperature methods that fit no group
criteria.borehole-tc.number: Number of conductivity measurements (borehole and mine)
criteria.borehole-tc.number-not-scored-for-litera: The number is not scored for a literature location (borehole and mine)
criteria.borehole-tc.pT-agreement: pT conditions must agree with the in-situ correction
criteria.m.classes: The four classes of the product
criteria.m.rounding: The product is rounded to three places
criteria.m.mark: The missing-information mark follows the M-score
criteria.m.not-determined: A score that cannot be calculated gives Mx
criteria.inherited.none: A parent with no child it rests on
criteria.inherited.flags: The flags of the poorest child
criteria.inherited.tie-on-u: A tie on the U-score is settled by the M-score
criteria.inherited.selection: Which children a parent rests on
criteria.missing-information.empty: An empty input takes the largest penalty and the mark
criteria.missing-information.unnamed-field: A field that the row which holds does not name may be empty: the row scores and nothing is missing
criteria.missing-information.unspecified-gives-no: An input recorded as unspecified takes the largest penalty and no mark
criteria.missing-information.gate: No interval depth sets the mark
criteria.missing-information.unresolvable-method: Temperature methods that fit no group set the mark
criteria.multi-valued.poorest: A field holding several values takes the poorest
criteria.child.whole: A child scored from its fields to its quality code
criteria.not-determined.all-empty: Every field the rules read is empty, so the scores are not determined
